coaching.headline: A proper win: the squad broke the base and finished the job.
coaching.team: Major objectives stayed with the squad, and the closing fights produced a demolished enemy base. The late outer-tower loss barely interrupted the finish; this was control with an ending, not endless foreplay around the river.

focus.title: Call the finish before the chase
focus.action: After the next won fight, the shot-caller should name the safest reachable structure and check the wave and team health; if the push is unsafe, call the reset immediately.

perPlayer.16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3: Wukong did excellent objective work and useful ward clearing. Keep both. Ward placement was poor, so put a ward on a safe approach before the next commitment. The jungle cannot keep running on good intentions and a flimsy condom of vision.
perPlayer.7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b: Murdock delivered strong carry damage. Keep that output, but review the late death instead of letting the win bury it. Before advancing into enemy jungle next game, confirm nearby peel and a route back. More damage is useless once the carry is dead.
perPlayer.a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: Scarlett supplied defense and strong warding, but no objective damage. Keep the defensive contribution and warding; make the next post-fight assignment explicit: guard the approach or hit the objective. Call the job and do it so the team knows what is covered.
perPlayer.a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: Steel contributed to takedowns without dying. Keep that shit. The next improvement is vision denial: check contested approaches with a teammate and clear reachable enemy wards before the objective setup. A clean combat game should come with a cleaner approach to the next fight.
perPlayer.10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Belica delivered strong damage, few deaths and objective contribution. Keep that shit. After the next safe fight win, keep adding damage to the objective once the approach is covered. This is a performance to repeat, not a reason to start tinkering with everything.

20.4.call: A 3-1 kill cluster ended at 20:55; an enemy outer tower fell eleven seconds later. The follow-through mattered.

24.7.call: Five enemy deaths, no allied deaths in this cluster. Two inner towers and two inhibitors fell from 25:07 through 25:46. That was the decisive damage to the base.

27.8.call: Four enemy deaths without an allied death in the closing cluster. The Core fell at 28:33. Finish secured.

16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.build: Wukong recorded strong objective damage while equipped with Manta Scythe, Infernum, The Perforator and Painweaver. No comparison here isolates their value, and the missing-magic-resist flag alone does not establish a build mistake.

7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b.build: Lightning Hawk, Vanquisher and Imperator match the recorded comparison core. Nothing in the death event establishes that a different item would have prevented it.

a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c.build: Mistmeadow Buckler, Terminus and Tainted Bastion differ from the comparison core. The mitigation total supports a defensive contribution, but cannot isolate item value or prove the build caused zero objective damage.

10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a.build: Combustion, Wraith Leggings, Caustica and Noxia were equipped. The performance supports keeping this as a useful baseline, not declaring the combination optimal or attributing the win to Caustica.

a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e.build: Fire Blossom, Xenia, Dynamo and Prophecy accompanied a deathless support game. That result does not isolate their individual value or prove the comparison core worse.
a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e.eternal: This review does not model Steel's Eternal contribution; no claim about its effectiveness follows from these totals.

threats: Chain-CC risk (4 hard-CC abilities, ~3.0s of lockdown): Riktor Riplash (pull), Riktor Shock Therapy (silence 0.8s), Riktor Skewer (suppress 1.25s), Bayle Kingslayer (knockback). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Lt. Belica Neural Disruptor (silence 0.5s). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
We have sustain (Steel) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Windsurge engage → Cyclebreaker damage-reduction spin → clones from 84000 Hairs
ourKits.winCondition: stance-dance for damage or tankiness and overwhelm with clones
ourKits.playWith: a team that fights alongside his clones
ourKits.playAgainst: AoE clears his clones; CC him during the damage-reduction window

ourKits.combo: Static Trap root → Buckshot → Hot Pursuit AS → Long Arm of the Law global snipe
ourKits.winCondition: trap for the root, then out-range with Shots Fired and finish with the global ult
ourKits.passive: every 5th basic is a long-range bonus shot
ourKits.playWith: frontline/peel to protect his low mobility
ourKits.playAgainst: almost no escape — engage past the trap and he dies

ourKits.combo: Bull Rush knockback → Force Shield wall → Shield Slam knockup+stun ult, Shield Bash %hp
ourKits.winCondition: peel the carry with walls/knockups or engage with Shield Slam
ourKits.playWith: a carry he can wall for and peel
ourKits.playAgainst: his Force Shield blocks projectiles — reposition around it; bait Shield Slam

ourKits.combo: Seismic Assault knockup → Void Bomb → Neural Disruptor silence ult, Void Drone mana drain
ourKits.winCondition: knock up + silence a target and burst with missing-HP scaling
ourKits.playAgainst: dodge Seismic Assault; she's immobile — dive when ult is down

enemyKits.combo: Riplash pull → Shock Therapy silence → Skewer suppress ult
enemyKits.winCondition: pull a target in and chain silence+suppress for a guaranteed kill
enemyKits.playWith: burst that deletes his pulled/suppressed target
enemyKits.playAgainst: respect Riplash range — stay spaced; cleanse/QSS the suppress

enemyKits.combo: Rushing Beat dashes → Line Tempo wolves → Circle Rhythm shield → All-Kill! wolfpack ult
enemyKits.winCondition: stack Track and unleash All-Kill! in a grouped fight
enemyKits.playAgainst: spread vs the wolfpack; she's squishy without her shield up

enemyKits.combo: Bramble Patch slow → Harvest Nettles stacks → Untamed Growth DoT → Fly Trap pull ult
enemyKits.winCondition: Fly Trap a clumped team and detonate AoE on the pull
enemyKits.passive: takedowns spawn growths + grant move speed
enemyKits.playWith: engage that clumps for her Fly Trap
enemyKits.playAgainst: spread out vs the pull; she's squishy — dive her

enemyKits.combo: Skull Crusher gap-close → Dire Howl slow → Cursed Edge → Kingslayer knockback dash, Berserk at low HP
enemyKits.winCondition: engage, drop low into Berserk and out-brawl
enemyKits.playWith: follow-up while he commits the dive
enemyKits.playAgainst: his Berserk rewards low HP — burst him fully or disengage; anti-heal helps

enemyKits.combo: Peekaboo! mark+slow → Knock, Knock! sniper → Back It Up! displacement ult
enemyKits.winCondition: land long-range snipes on marked targets and reset on takedowns
enemyKits.playWith: engage that holds a target in his sniper line
enemyKits.playAgainst: close the gap — he's weak point-blank; dodge the skillshot snipe

murdock.loadout: Vermis (Serration + Melting Point), augment Justice's Reach, crest Pacifier
lines: Lead story: Hard to kill. Died 2 times in 29 minutes, fewer deaths than about 88% of Murdock carry players this patch. The build added healing off damage.
Murdock dealt 31,415 hero damage, 28% of their team's, with +182 physical power from items.

Penetration: Vanquisher 12; against Bayle (level 16: about 108 physical armor, 96 after penetration; took 7,259 physical damage from heroes, 40% of all hero damage they took) and Riktor (level 14: about 187 physical armor, 175 after penetration; took 20,237 physical damage from heroes, 60% of all hero damage they took) that is about 6% and 4% more damage (estimate: percent penetration taken before flat).
Lightning Hawk (item): While moving or landing Basic Attacks: Generate stacks of Momentum. At 100 stacks empower your next Basic Attack On-Hit. Deal 40 (+20%) Damage. Slows by 20% for 0.75s.
Imperator (item): Critical Strikes deal 30% more damage.
Pacifier (crest): Dash a short distance. Empower your next Physical Damage Instance within 3s. Deals 30 (+25%) Damage. Increased by 2.5x against Targets below 20% Max Health.
Vermis (Eternal): Every 3rd consecutive Basic Attack on the same Enemy Hero within 2.5s deals 3% (+0.25% per Level) of their Max Health as bonus Physical Damage.
Serration (Eternal minor): Vermis also deals 3.5% of the target's Missing Health as bonus Physical Damage.
Melting Point (Eternal minor): Deal 10% bonus damage to targets with more than 125 Physical Armor.
Sustain: 7% lifesteal; 2,441 healing recorded.
Stack (Every basic attack set off): 2 effects on one trigger: Lightning Hawk, Vermis.
The Eternal was part of it: Vermis (Serration + Melting Point) sits on the same trigger as the items (every basic attack set off), so the same hits paid out twice.
Countered? 2 of the 4 players Murdock killed built physical armor (Riktor, Shinbi). We killed Murdock 2 times.

Copy it? Vermis (Serration + Melting Point): 46.6% in 1,785 Murdock carry games, below the hero's 48.6%; this 3-item core: 55% in 616 games, above the 53.7% of that hero-role's cores. Mixed: copy the part that wins, not the whole setup.

lt-belica.loadout: Aion (Bottomless Vial + Runic Focus), augment Combat Veteran, crest Soulbearer
lines: Lead story: Hard to kill. Died 1 time in 29 minutes, fewer deaths than about 90% of Lt. Belica mid players this patch. The build added healing off damage.
Neural Disruptor at rank 3: 85s base, about 66.4s by the end (22% shorter) from 28 ability haste: Noxia 20, Soulbearer 8.
Lt. Belica dealt 31,192 hero damage, 28% of their team's, with +380 magical power from items.

Penetration: Combustion 9, Wraith Leggings 11, Caustica ignores 35%; against Wraith (level 14: about 47 magical armor, 11 after penetration; took 7,774 magical damage from heroes, 44% of all hero damage they took) and The Fey (level 16: about 46 magical armor, 10 after penetration; took 9,278 magical damage from heroes, 77% of all hero damage they took) that is about 33% and 33% more damage (estimate: percent penetration taken before flat).
Combustion (item): On dealing Ability Damage: Deal 50 (+18%) Damage to the Target and nearby Enemies.
Wraith Leggings (item): Against Heroes below 40% Health: Abilities deal 12% bonus Magical Damage.
Caustica (item): On dealing Ability Damage to a Hero: While they are above 50% Health. For every point of Bonus Magical Armor they possess. Deal 0.2% more Damage.
Noxia (item): Deal 6% of Target's Maximum Health as bonus Damage.
Aion (Eternal): Casting a spell grants 1 Mana Regeneration for 8s (stacks 5x). Spells also grant gold equal to 6% of damage dealt to Enemy Heroes.
Sustain: Soulbearer: Gain a 100 (+35) (+6%) Shield for 8s. Gain 20% Magical Lifesteal and 10% Movement Speed for 8s.; 2,344 healing recorded.

Lesson: Lt. Belica's penetration cut through: Wraith took about 33% more magical damage than their armor alone allows (estimate: at level 14 their armor was about 47, about 11 after 20 flat + 35% penetration).

Stack (Every ability hit set off): 4 effects on one trigger: Combustion, Wraith Leggings, Caustica, Noxia. Lt. Belica has 4 damaging abilities (Void Bomb, Seismic Assault, Void Drone hit an area, so one cast sets them off on several heroes), and 28 ability haste brought them back 22% sooner: more casts, more triggers.
Countered? 1 of the 4 players Lt. Belica killed built magical armor (Riktor). We killed Lt. Belica 1 time.
Copy it? Aion (Bottomless Vial + Runic Focus): 53.5% in 172 Lt. Belica midlane games, above the hero's 51.6%. Proven this patch: worth copying.
